title: Augmented presheaves over a representable and their total summand bound
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small category and let $s$ be a working universe containing its objects and arrows [def-weil-size-convention]. Use the set-presheaf and semirepresentable conventions of [def-cbc-derived-hypersheaf-presentation], and formal families [def-weil-pbc-formal-coproduct]. For $T\in\mathcal C$, write $h_T(V)=\operatorname{Hom}(V,T)$. The category of augmented simplicial presheaves over $h_T$ is the slice of simplicial set presheaves over the constant simplicial object $h_T$; its objects are diagrams $U_\bullet$ with their actual augmentation $U_\bullet\to h_T$, and its morphisms commute with that augmentation. Regard such an object as an augmented simplicial presheaf with target exactly $h_T$. For a cardinal $\kappa$ in the working universe, it has total summand bound $\kappa$ when there exist $s$-small formal families $A_n=\{A_{n,i}\}_{i\in I_n}$ and isomorphisms $\coprod_{i\in I_n}h_{A_{n,i}}\cong U_n$ for every $n\geq0$, such that $|\coprod_{n\geq0} I_n|<\kappa$. Every summand in every degree is counted, including degenerate summands.

source.place: Dugger--Hollander--Isaksen, arXiv:math/0205027v2, Definition 4.2, Section 4.14, Definition 6.1 and Section 6.5
